description: This source file provides an implementation layer for POSIX threads (pthreads) on Windows, wrapping Windows-specific threading APIs to emulate pthread functions such as pthread_create, pthread_join, pthread_self, and pthread_cond_wait.

methods.name: unsigned __stdcall win32_start_routine(void * arg)
methods.description: Thread start routine that sets the thread ID and executes the user-provided start routine.

methods.name: int pthread_create(pthread_t * thread,const void * attr UNUSED,void * (* start_routine)(void *),void * arg)
methods.description: Creates a new thread using Windows API, wrapping it in a pthread_t structure.

methods.name: int win32_pthread_join(pthread_t * thread,void ** value_ptr)
methods.description: Waits for the specified thread to finish execution and retrieves its return value.

methods.name: pthread_t pthread_self(void)
methods.description: Returns the thread identifier for the calling thread.

methods.name: int pthread_cond_wait(pthread_cond_t * cond,pthread_mutex_t * mutex)
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable, using Windows API SleepConditionVariableCS.
